scope: Produce one Dr. Social concept/model sheet for every style in the registered catalog, in catalog order, preserving the approved identity and model-sheet form.

catalog.sequence_rule: Use the complete registered catalog order. The approved CPS2-Alpha-Cel sheet is item 1; the next item is Dark-Gothic-Pop.

owner_direction: On 2026-10-07 the owner approved the Dr. Social model-sheet document and authorized generating and registering the style series.

standard_form.lineup: Horizontal; front, profile, and back share scale and baseline.
standard_form.background: Clean neutral white, cream, or light gray; no scenery or visual noise.
required_style_fields: biotype options and selected character biotype
standard_form.selected_biotype: Tall, slim ectomorph; lean adult with long limbs and narrow-to-average shoulders.

character_invariants: Keep the owner-approved Dr. Ferdinand Social identity, face, gray swept-back hair, round brass spectacles, age, and slim ectomorph morphology.
Keep the established Master of Darkness palette roles and clothing colors; style-specific lighting may change contrast but not recolor identity materials.
Preserve the cane, rapier, and occult steel boomerang; violet is restricted to the boomerang effect.
Remain fully human: no fangs, wings, claws, monster transformation, or unapproved costume/symbol changes.
Use a consistent scale, five-view layout, neutral background, and readable metadata on every sheet.
review_policy: Each generated sheet is a candidate until owner review; no sprite, animation, resource, ROM, or emulator approval is implied. Record exact style reference and SHA-256 for every output.
